newsitem.title: USA: US Facilities sees year operating net gains.
newsitem.headline: US Facilities sees year operating net gains.

text.p: US Facilities Corp said Tuesday it is on track for further revenue increases and expects to achieve operating earnings gains for 1997, assuming present business trends continue.

"While total revenues for the 1997 quarter grew 29 percent over last year, we anticipate overall growth to approximate 15-20 percent for the year, a growth rate that we believe is sustainable," said chairman and chief executive David Cargile.

The company said Tuesday that continued growth in its property/casualty business together with expansion in its medical lines business resulted in higher premiums earned, commissions and fees and net investment income.

For the quarter ended March 31, 1997, revenues increased 29 percent to $50,193,000, compared with $38,918,000 in the year-ago quarter. Net income decreased to $3,660,000, or $0.60 per share from $3,808,000, or $0.64 per share, as realized gains for the period decreased by $0.06 per share.

Net operating income increased to $3,545,000, or $0.58 per share, compared with $3,330,000, or $0.56 per share, in the same period last year, despite an increase in the income tax rate to 29.9 percent from 23.5 percent, as prior tax benefits were no longer available.
